Director (PDUNASS),

All RPFCs, Regional Offices,

All Officers in-charge of SROs

Sub: Revised rate of interest — with regard to Staff Provident Fund in EPFO -
regarding.
Sir,
I am directed to invite a reference to Resolution no. 5(1)-B (PD)/2016 dated 03.10.2016
issued by Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) regarding declaration of rate of
interest of General Provident Fund (GPF) and other similar funds (copy enclosed).

2. In this regard, I am directed to convey that accumulations at the credit of subscribers to
the Staff Provident Fund shall carry interest at the rate of 8.0% (Eight percent) w.e.f. 01.10.2016
to 31.12.2016 as per the Government of India, Ministry of Finance resolution dated 03.10.2016.

Encl: as above
Yours faithfully,

Ji
(Rahul Arya)
